name: rulake-ruqu
description: ruQu — quantum simulation substrate for ruLake. Adds the ruqu-mcp wire (5 tools: simulate, verify, replay, optimize, qec_schedule) plus 5 slash commands. All 5 tools route through real upstream libs: ruqu-core (~26k LOC SIMD-accelerated state-vector simulator) for simulate/verify/replay/optimize and ruqu-algorithms surface_code for qec_schedule.
